---
title: "Records"
subtitle: "Non-gridded data: time series, sites and profiles"
---

The Records datasets hold data that are not on a grid: ice core series, greenhouse
gases, global sea level, benthic δ18O stacks, orbital elements and insolation, relative sea level indicators, borehole temperature profiles, GPS uplift rates, point measurements of
the surface mass balance, and freshwater fluxes by region. They are made from the
original sources, like the gridded datasets, but not remapped: each product is one
NetCDF file, or several (e.g. one per ice core), following the CF conventions for
discrete sampling geometries (see [Records format](records.qmd)), with the sites, their
coordinates and the data. Each NetCDF file has a [text form](records.qmd#text-form)
next to it (`.txt`), for reading without a NetCDF library. They are not split by
domain: a model reads a file and selects its sites.

Records are released on the domain `Records`, one package per dataset, and go to
`$FESMDATA/Records/<Dataset>/<Dataset>-<Product>[-<part>].nc` and `.txt` (see
[Download](download.qmd)):

```bash
julia fesmdata.jl list Records              # the records datasets
julia fesmdata.jl fetch IceCores Records    # one of them
```
